readBy: programs/resolver.hoon (compiled INTO the resolver: the table is data, but a Nock sample carries only field values, so a table change = a new resolver jam = a new {VK_RESOLVER}); sim.py; the MUD-REFEREE lane

lawBounds.why: every damage below is <= MAXHIT; sheet law clause 22 refuses a referee turn that exceeds it whatever the table says

flee.note: a `go DIR` that also writes intent := 4; the referee charges the balance on its next tick

cure.note: not an intent: `send --to REF --asset HERB --amount 1 --topic cure/AFF` (M8 send-with-payment); the referee burns the herb (K-WELL) and writes aff := 0

pray.note: only while dead (law clause 9); the referee revives at HOME with HPMAX once now >= respawn

effect.checkedBy: the resolver only (a computed effect; no clause can see a miss)

ward.lapses: the referee may lower it at any time (a lapse is not a hurt)

resolution: 1 read attacker (joint 0) and defender (joint 1) sheets and the skill named by the intent's skill code
2 if defender dead or not in the attacker's room: clear the attacker's intent, no other write
3 damage = skill.damage - (1 if attacker clumsy else 0), floored at 0
4 affliction: set the skill's affliction unless the defender's defence blocks it
5 attacker: bal|eq := now + action.cost; intent := 0; target := 0
6 defender: hp -= damage; if hp <= 0: alive := 0, deaths += 1, respawn := now + RESPAWN; burn ESSENCE_ON_DEATH essence (a separate K-WELL turn)
